subject: Request: permission stewardship artifacts for SOC 2 / SIG review
messages:
From: Aaron Park <aaron.park@helixhealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: security@helixhealth.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: permission stewardship artifacts for SOC 2 / SIG review

Hi Marissa,

As part of HelixHealth's SIG and SOC 2 intake, our auditors are asking us to provide a compact access custody package for a sample tenant. Specifically they'd like:

- SAML assertion examples (successful and expired/failed samples) covering SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows
- SCIM delta export showing provisioning/deprovisioning events for April–May 2026
- RBAC role matrix showing roles, permissions, and typical owners (CSV or XLSX)
- Service account inventory with "owner"/"purpose"/"last-used" columns
- A short narrative (1 page) describing how least-privilege is enforced and how role changes are audited

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide these artifacts for HelixHealth's sample tenant? Target delivery requested by 2026-06-04 to keep our reporting timeline. If some items need redaction, please indicate the expected turnaround.

Thanks,
Aaron Park
Audit Lead, HelixHealth
security@helixhealth.com

[Attachment: Helix_SIG_Request.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Park <aaron.park@helixhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: permission stewardship artifacts for SOC 2 / SIG review

Hi Aaron — thanks for the clear list and timeline. We can provide the package by end-of-day 2026-06-03 with the following plan:

- SAML assertion samples: will deliver redacted assertion XMLs (remove PII and transient IDs)
- SCIM deltas: export as CSV with event_type, timestamp, actor, target_user, attributes_changed
- RBAC matrix: XLSX with role -> permission mapping and owner column
- Service account inventory: CSV pulled from our internal inventory service, we will mark any high-privilege accounts for review
- Narrative: 1-page summary + references to our runbook and audit log retention policy

We will include an accompanying checklist noting any redactions and why. If Helix has a preferred redaction method, let us know, otherwise we will mask emails and account IDs.

Laura and Jonas — I'm looping you in to own the SAML and SCIM extracts.

Marissa Cole
Manager, Security & Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: acknowledgement_stub.txt]

Subject: INTERNAL: HelixHealth access package — task split

Internal note — brief checklist and owners:

- Laura: export SAML assertion samples (SP & IdP flows). Redact NameID and any user PII; include one expired assertion and one malformed-assertion example for audit context. Deliver to /secure-share by EOD 6/2.

Thanks — M.
